learning_outcomes.text: This course explains the fundamental principles and industrial application areas of sheet metal forming processes.

It describes the working principles of cutting and punching dies; determines the punch-die clearance and calculates and analyzes cutting force, cutting energy, and burr formation using punch geometry and material strength values.

It explains the mechanical principles of sheet metal bending; calculates and analyzes the unfolding length, bending force, and elastic springback using engineering relationships, taking into account the displacement of the neutral axis.

It defines the elements and functions of deep drawing dies; calculates and evaluates the drawing ratio (LDR), tensile force, and pressure plate force depending on sheet metal thickness, material properties, and die geometry.
It explains the principles of die and tool design used in sheet metal forming; performs appropriate die and tool design for a given part, considering force and geometric calculations.

syllabus_topics: Sheet metal former, introduction, application fields, manufacturing of sheets.
Classification of Sheet Metal Forming Processes.
Theory and Calculations of Cutting and Drilling Processes.
Cutting and Punching Die Design: Dimensioning of cutting die elements, punch/die calculations, material selection, etc.
Cutting and Punching Die Design: Dimensioning of cutting die elements, punch/die calculations, material selection, etc.
Fundamentals of Bending Processes: Bending methods (air bending, free bending, die bending), calculation of springback, bending angle, and bending force.
Bending Dies and Design: Bending die elements, die cavity selection, punch radius, bending force calculation examples.
Fundamentals of Deep Drawing Process: Deep drawing mechanism, drawing ratio, flange flow, wrinkling/tearing defects.
Deep Drawing Dies and Calculations: Die elements, holder pressure, die radius, drawing force calculation, multi-stage drawing.
Progressive (Step) Dies: Working principle of progressive dies, strip placement, step number calculations.
Progressive (Step) Dies: Working principle of progressive dies, strip placement, step number calculations.
Die Materials and Surface Treatments: Mold steel types, heat treatments, surface coatings, wear/density analysis
Die Assembly and Work Safety: Die assembly techniques, press machines, occupational safety, maintenance.
